description: A red sports car drives through a neon-lit city street at night, side view.

spec.subject: A glossy red two-door sports car with low-slung bodywork, black tinted windows, silver alloy wheels, and clean reflective paint
spec.setting: Nighttime urban street lined with bright neon storefront signs and wet pavement reflecting colored light; foreground shows the car passing close to camera, midground is the lane and curb, background is a blur of illuminated shopfronts and traffic lights
spec.action: The sports car drives steadily across frame along the street
spec.camera_angle: profile side view, eye level, medium-wide shot, 50mm lens, car centered horizontally with enough space ahead in frame for motion
spec.camera_movement: tracking sideways at matched speed, keeping the car centered
spec.lighting: Neon signs from both sides of the street provide hard colored highlights in pink, cyan, and blue; streetlights add a softer overhead fill; reflections ripple across the car’s body and the wet road; no visible haze
spec.style: digital capture with crisp detail and slight motion blur on the background, cool neon-heavy color grade with saturated magenta and cyan reflections, urban night-racing look

human.critique: snowy mountain road, not neon city
natural sunset light, not neon night
